fields.name: Mods
fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x127ED80 allocates 0x30 and zeroes a HashSet; destructor thunk_FUN_140582ad0 frees its three arrays only (trivial keys). Windows gui::mod::RequestSystem (reaches it through the storage index DAT_14631f264: getter bg3.exe+0x127BE80, component stride 0x30): bg3.exe+0x127DD20 (~ CollectRequestsFromSubscriptionSync) and bg3.exe+0x127CA60 insert 8-byte mod (UGC) ids with bg3.exe+0x721030 (find/insert comparing 8-byte keys); the update bg3.exe+0x127B600 clears it each frame (bg3.exe+0x5C4330) when its key count +0x2C is non-zero.

summary: Client mod browser: ids of mods whose subscription or download was cancelled while resolving dependencies (gui::mod::RequestSystem). Singleton, empty in all samples (idle).
open_questions: The ids are mod/UGC ids by context (the system's other sets and maps are keyed by unsigned __int64 mod ids); no game member name.
second_pass: Found the Windows writers through the storage index DAT_14631f264: bg3.exe+0x127DD20 and bg3.exe+0x127CA60 insert 8-byte keys with bg3.exe+0x721030 and the RequestSystem update clears the set every frame - shape and key width are Windows-established.
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
